comparison.objective: Carry a long thin panel to a rack while choosing support points that prevent excessive bow; not tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual compliant-body support, grasp-point selection, coordinated carrying, and rail placement versus rigid fine-tool adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Panel must reach the rack without roughly 4 mm or greater harmful bow; exact scorer threshold and final seating tolerance are not fully specified in the record.
comparison.reason: This tests distributed support of a deformable object, a materially different ability.
